title: Apply stops at its deadline, a run that wrote nothing of a description fails, and the demo company's contacts, offices and prices do not stay on the customer's Joomla site
steps: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/brief-build.test.mjs test/brief-joomla.test.mjs test/joomla-site-words.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'an apply cut at its deadline writes nothing after it' is ok: the row ends failed 'took too long', the engine's write after the deadline is refused, and only the write before it reached the door.
'an Apply that wrote nothing of a description it was given fails, with what happened' is ok: state failed, error carries 'none of your text was written' and the engine's note, timings.wrote 0.
'an Apply that wrote nothing it had nothing to write from says so on the finished row and to the gate' is ok: a brief with no description in English still ends applied with the note.

'About given, no phone or address: the offices strip goes unwritten and the identity keeps no detail of the demo company' is ok: module-812 is among the hidden modules, none of module-812.4/5/6 is written, and module-4369.1/.2/.4/.5/.6/.7 are written as empty strings.

'the seven modules that are nothing but the template's facts, and the four lists of its places and prices, are unpublished' is ok: Tracy Business hides modules 447 810 812 837 840 841 842 844 847 849 855.
'About left blank, a name given' is ok: only the four lists 810 812 840 847 are hidden; the seven fact modules stay published.
The contact-record test 'a design that is not another company's is not judged' is ok: the visible record's telephone is emptied when no phone was given.
Every other test of the three files stays ok.

selectors.deadline: recordedDoor in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/shared.js refuses calls once ctx.signal fired; brief-build.js gives apply its own signal (applyStop)
selectors.nothing written: wordsAsked and the wrote === 0 branch in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-build.js
selectors.identity: the emptied set in prepare of apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/joomla.js (resolveChromeSlots of the seeder's chrome-slots)
selectors.lists: isFactList in apps/tracy-web/src/lib/fact-fields.js; factModules in joomla.js

evidence: TCH #1367 (production jurgens and ali-barber, 13/10/2026) re-run on the local stand at develop a1410fd154, 15/10/2026: ali-barber (Tracy Business Joomla, Dutch) ended failed at the 180 s apply deadline and the engine kept writing 19-23 s after; all 13 pages read showed 8 800 550-67-90, sales@northgate-ind.ru, the Kaluga address, three +7 offices and 'from ₽48,000/m²'.
fence: The real brief engines and build over a scratch Postgres schema with model and CMS doubles. Not exercised here: a running CMS (covered by the stand re-run on the PR).
